thread:
Maya: heads-up, customer BlueCedar just opened an escalation. Their bulk embeddings job started seeing 400s and huge tail latency after a nightly upload. ~8-12% error rate reported.

Oliver: error sample?

Maya: pasted from them:

```
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
Content-Type: application/json
{
  \"error\": \"DimensionMismatch\",
  \"message\": \"Expected embedding dimension 1536 but received 1024 for request element 42\",
  \"request_id\": \"r_c9e7b1d2\"
}
```

Maya: they batch ~200 inputs per request, mostly plain text. They said they didn't change client code.

Jun: default embed model for their org is text-embed-large-1536. If any items were precomputed 1024-d vectors, that would explain it.

Leah: we should check ingress batching trace for r_c9e7b1d2. Could be dynamic batch mixed types or a routing change mid-batch.

support-oncall: pulled logs:

[2026-03-15T02:14:05Z] request r_c9e7b1d2 accepted, incoming_batch_size=205, max_batch_window=30ms
[2026-03-15T02:14:05Z] routing -> model_variant=text-embed-large-1536
[2026-03-15T02:14:05Z] batch assembled: components={raw_text:185, precomputed_vector:20} dims=[1536 x185, 1024 x20]
[2026-03-15T02:14:05Z] encoder: skipping encode for precomputed elements
[2026-03-15T02:14:05Z] error: DimensionMismatch element_index=42 -> rejecting batch

Jun: yep, dynamic batcher is combining heterogeneous items. That's a bug: we cannot combine encoded vectors and raw text in same batch.

Maya: customer confirms they run two producers: a web uploader (text) and a legacy transform job that sometimes submits precomputed vectors to the same /v1/embeddings path. They said the legacy pipeline was \"supposed\" to call a different endpoint but the config drifted.

Leah: immediate mitigation options for customer:
- Explicitly set model=\"text-embed-large-1536\" in requests so routing is consistent.
- Reduce max_batch_size to 1 (or 8) to avoid large mixed batches forming.
- Split traffic: have legacy job target separate credentials or a different endpoint so different input schemas don't collide.

Oliver: does max_batch_size=1 help tail latency? It stops batching so p50 will rise but tail variability caused by waiting for large batches will go away. For short-term debugging it's fine.

support-oncall: additionally we observed sporadic 500s when batch_size > 120 in their tenant while requests landed on the cheaper GPU variant. Logs show memory kernel failures when mixed dims were present.

Jun: proposed runtime fixes (ENG-RT):
- Batcher: add group key = (model_name, input_kind, vector_dim_if_present) so only homogeneous items batch together.
- Validate payload early: if inputs mix raw_text and precomputed vectors -> 400 with message \"mixed input types: split text and precomputed vectors into separate requests\" and include expected_dim when relevant.
- Emit metric: runtime.batch_mixed_inputs.count and alarm if > 0.
- Short-term guard: detect mixed dims at router and short-circuit with 400 rather than letting batcher assemble.

Leah: I'll draft a support note and an SDK patch that warns when clients call embeddings with mixed input types. Also adding an integration test that simulates mixed payloads to ensure rejection.

support-oncall: filed ENG-RT-5201 assigned to Jun. Attached sanitized reproducer and logs. Priority: P2. Estimated hotfix timeline: 36-48h for guard to be canaried. Full rollout + SDKs ~1 week.

Maya: can we push a temporary server-side guard ASAP to reduce customer impact? They asked for ETA in next 24h.

Jun: we can ship a small router-side guard that inspects a batch's incoming elements and rejects mixed schemas within ~36h with canary. Will post PR and canary link.

Oliver: support message to BlueCedar to send now:
1) Please set explicit model param to text-embed-large-1536.
2) Temporarily set max_batch_size=1 or reduce to 8 in your client config.
3) Confirm whether any payload items are already vectors; if so, split those into separate requests.
4) We're escalating (ENG-RT-5201) and will notify when a guard is deployed.

Maya: customer responded they're okay to lower batch size for tonight and will audit their legacy job. Thanks!

Leah: follow-ups for ENG-RT:
- add unit and e2e tests preventing mixed-batch assembly
- add explicit error messages with request_id and expected dimension to help customers debug
- add dashboard tile showing mixed-input reject rate by org

Jun: also noted that routing rules sometimes pick cheaper variants for non-critical traffic; ensure model routing doesn't cause vector-dim changes mid-aggregation. We'll tighten routing keys used by batcher.

incident-bot: escalation ENG-RT-5201 created and assigned to Jun.

Maya: i'll update BlueCedar with the temporary mitigations and mark the case as escalated. Will close thread when hotfix is deployed.

If anyone sees more 4xx DimensionMismatch spikes, please @support-oncall and include a sample request_id.
